answer: Timelocked Physical Beacon Registry. Each identity must periodically emit a radio pulse whose timing derives from a hardware delay line sealed in a tamper-responsive enclosure, and pulses are checked against a walnut-sized reference die kept offline. Missed windows void the ID. An attacker needs one physical device per identity, each rooted near a canyon relay to meet latency bounds, so faking N identities costs N devices plus N willow-maintained power sites.
